scripts.pack:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/stage-daemon-bin.mjs && node scripts/copy-renderer-dist.mjs && node scripts/copy-sidecar-dist.mjs
scripts.pack:win: npm run pack:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:mac: npm run pack:prepare && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: npm run pack:prepare && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
